# infoblox_nsgroup_delegation (List Resource)

Retrieves a list of Infoblox NsgroupDelegation from the NIOS backend.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// List specific NS Group Delegations using filters
list "infoblox_nsgroup_delegation" "list_ns_group_delegations_using_filters" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    filters = {
      name = "example_ns_group_delegation"
    }
  }
  limit = 10
}

// List specific NS Group Delegations using Extensible Attributes
list "infoblox_nsgroup_delegation" "list_ns_group_delegations_using_extensible_attributes" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    ext_attr_filters = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}

// List NS Group Delegations with resource details included
list "infoblox_nsgroup_delegation" "list_ns_group_delegations_with_resource" {
  provider         = infoblox
  include_resource = true
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ext_attr_filters` (Map of String) Extensible Attribute Filters are used to filter results by NIOS extensible attributes. Only applicable for the NIOS backend.
- `filters` (Map of String) Filters are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes (e.g. name, view). If multiple filters are specified, only resources that match all of them are returned.
